Named HTML entities like &mdash; and &hellip; are decoded

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Em dash&mdash;used for parenthetical remarks&mdash;is common. Ellipsis&hellip; indicates omission. Non-breaking&nbsp;space.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
